source.name: Siemens – Siemens and Oracle Red Bull Racing celebrate 20 years of innovation
source.quote: Siemens Digital Industries Software is celebrating the 20th anniversary of its collaboration with Oracle Red Bull Racing

note: Siemens's December 2024 release ('Since 2004...') marks the 20th anniversary of the collaboration; the team's own partner page says 'a partner since our inception in 2005'. The Siemens release's 2004 is taken for the deal start.
